tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Page ground (Ink by night, cream paper by day). Ground for ivory and ivory-dim text.

tokens.name: night-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: Panel, cards, ring offset of an active Bubble.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on night and night-2; the reversed fill of the mark.

tokens.name: ivory-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, placeholders (at 50%) on night and night-2.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Sovereign Gold, the base accent; hover state of gold buttons.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold for highlights, primary buttons (text night on it), the 2px focus ring, selection, warn tone.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Brand Kit primary mark colour. Only on Cream or white grounds; on dark the mark reverses to ivory.

tokens.name: kurinji
tokens.usage: Kurinji bloom violet. Kurinji accent; also the default --accent.

tokens.name: mullai
tokens.usage: Mullai forest green. Also the ok tone: verified, on-device, success, done steps.

tokens.name: marutham
tokens.usage: Marutham paddy gold-green. Legal disclaimer edge (Nyaya).

tokens.name: neytal
tokens.usage: Neytal sea blue. Also the info tone: yazhi-api runtime, children's notice.

tokens.name: palai
tokens.usage: Palai ochre red. Also the risk tone: confirm gates, failures, urgent. (tokens.css :root has #c25b3c; the Bubble dark value is #d6704f.)

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The live accent. Each app or tiṇai scope points it at its own hue (AppFrame sets it from the app; TinaiScope from env-accent). Eyebrows, citation marks, current step, accent edges.

tokens.name: palai-ground
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). Landscape ground; inside a TinaiScope it replaces night.

tokens.name: palai-surface
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). Raised surface in the landscape; replaces night-2.

tokens.name: palai-hi
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). The bright stroke: focus rings, links, the one bright mark of a Hairline figure.

tokens.name: palai-edge
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). Hairline rules and borders (.hair at 55%, .hair-lo at 28%); range track.

tokens.name: palai-mid
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). Mid-tone hairline for figures and ambient fields.

tokens.name: palai-lo
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). Faint hairline for figures and ambient fields.

tokens.name: palai-accent
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). The landscape's accent; becomes --accent inside the scope. In dark it reads 4.87:1 on palai-surface and 5.14:1 on palai-ground, so small accent text passes AA everywhere (it was #c25b3c, 4.32:1 on the surface).

tokens.name: palai-text
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). Body text on this landscape's ground and surface; replaces ivory.

tokens.name: palai-text-dim
tokens.usage: Palai (Heat over sand). Secondary text on this landscape's ground and surface; replaces ivory-dim.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only: Playfair Display Black, −3px tracking. Never substitute the face.

styles.usage: Section headings at text-4xl (Playfair Display Bold, --leading-latin-display 1.1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Section headings at text-xl (Playfair Display Bold, --leading-latin-display 1.1).

styles.name: body-xl

styles.name: tamil-lg

styles.name: tamil-base

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Pills, eyebrows and gate labels: uppercase, tracking-wider. Latin only.

styles.name: mono-xs
styles.usage: Ticket ids, verse numbers, confirm-word input.

spacing.note: Bubble components use Tailwind's default 4px spacing scale; these are the system's own spacing tokens.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical section spacing at its maximum; the source is clamp(5rem, 12vh, 9rem), which the page cannot hold, so the upper bound is recorded.

tokens.name: max-w
tokens.usage: Maximum content width of site sections.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and site panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, composer, bubbles, Mission Control.

bubble.note: Tray bubble radii, ratio 1 : 0.74 : 0.55 (modules/pack.ts). The Yazhi mark keeps its own 1.00 : 0.74 : 0.56.

tokens.name: bubble-l
tokens.usage: Radius of a large tray bubble: most work behind it.

tokens.name: bubble-m
tokens.usage: Radius of a medium tray bubble.

tokens.name: bubble-s
tokens.usage: Radius of a small tray bubble.
